_comment: Jurisdiction-neutral business defaults for an FTO screening. Project metadata or command-line arguments take precedence. Do not reuse a prior product, company, jurisdiction, date range, or search expression.

_field_notes.target_company: Optional competitors, assignees, or rights holders. Separate multiple names with commas, semicolons, or line breaks.
_field_notes.ipc_filter: Optional IPC restriction, for example B60R21/ or B62D25/. Leave blank unless technically justified.
_field_notes.cpc_filter: Optional CPC restriction. Leave blank unless technically justified.
_field_notes.main_classification_filter: Optional main-classification restriction. Do not treat classification coverage as a completeness guarantee.
_field_notes.simple_legal_status_filter: Optional PatSnap SIMPLE_LEGAL_STATUS query value. A value such as 1 is only a search filter and does not prove current enforceability.
_field_notes.authority: Target patent authority or a user-approved PatSnap query expression, for example US, EP, JP, or GB. Do not default silently.
_field_notes.relevant_acts: Jurisdiction-specific commercial acts in scope, such as making, using, selling, offering, importing, exporting, or supplying.
_field_notes.search_cutoff: Date through which patent publications are searched, in ISO 8601 format.
_field_notes.status_cutoff: Date as of which legal-status evidence is assessed, in ISO 8601 format.
_field_notes.family_counting_convention: Publication, application, grant, simple family, extended family, or another documented unit.
_field_notes.max_feature_pair_queries: Maximum automatically constructed important-feature/ordinary-feature combinations. Every generated query remains reviewable and attributable.
